PLAN "12-week Bodyweight Strength - Beginner (Home, Mat + Pull-up Bar)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build full-body strength with bodyweight"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 40m "Upper Push/Pull":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 40m "Lower & Core":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          reverse_lunge 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dead_bug 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 35m "Full Body & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 3x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          squat 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30..45s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper Push/Pull - Progress":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 4x6..10 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x35..50s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower & Core - Progress":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          dead_bug 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Full Body Strength":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x8..12 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          chin_up 4x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          squat 4x10..15 rpe 7 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x40..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Strength":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          inverted_row 4x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dip 3x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hollow_hold 3x20..40s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 45m "Lower Strength":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 4x12..18 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          split_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 4x10..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x45..60s rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 40m "Skill & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jump_rope 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 3x15..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          chin_up 4x3..6 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          jump_squat 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          mountain_climber 3x30..45s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          calf_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 50m "Upper Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x10..15 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          inverted_row 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          shoulder_press 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..20 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x12..18 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          walking_lunge 4x10..12 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          glute_bridge 4x12..20 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          side_plank 3x20..40s rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 45m "Full Body Test & Conditioning":
        warmup:
          jogging 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 4xmax..max rpe 9 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 4xmax..max rpe 9 rest 120 seconds
          squat 4x15..20 rpe 8 rest 75 seconds
          plank 3x60..90s rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
  PHASE "Phase 2 - Strength Build" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 55m "Upper Strength Focus":
        warmup:
          arm_circles 5m
        main straight_sets:
          push_up 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chin_up 5x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dip 4x6..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          prone_Y 3x12..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 55m "Lower Strength Focus":
        warmup:
          leg_swings 5m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 5x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          pistol_progression  (Note: not in vocab; substitute) 
    WEEK 5 ERROR:
      This document contains an invalid exercise name. Replace unknown exercises with closest from vocabulary.
